# Sunfabb

> Premium handcrafted home textiles from India - bedspreads, towels, napkins and table linen.

Sunfabb is an Indian home-textiles brand crafting bedspreads, towels, napkins and table linen for quality-conscious homes.
All products are made in India with natural fibres and are designed for everyday comfort and lasting quality.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sunfabb.com): Brand entry point and featured collections
- [Catalog](https://sunfabb.com/catalog): Full product browse with category and filter support
- [Guides](https://sunfabb.com/guides): Practical guides on choosing and caring for home textiles
- [FAQ](https://sunfabb.com/faq): Answers on fabric weight, sizing, and care
- [Contact](https://sunfabb.com/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, email and enquiry form

## Collections

- [Bedspreads](https://sunfabb.com/catalog?category=bedspreads): Cotton bedspreads in multiple sizes and weaves
- [Towels](https://sunfabb.com/catalog?category=towels): Bath and hand towels
- [Napkins](https://sunfabb.com/catalog?category=napkins): Table napkins in natural cotton
- [Table Linen](https://sunfabb.com/catalog?category=table-linen): Tablecloths and placemats

## Products

Individual product pages are at /catalog/[slug]. Each page includes the product name, description, available sizes, material, colour options, price in INR, care instructions, and high-resolution images.

## Guides

Reference articles at /guides/[slug]. Each is fact-dense and India-specific, with tables of measurements and weights.

- [Towel GSM explained](https://sunfabb.com/guides/towel-gsm-explained): What GSM means, what each weight band feels like, drying times, and which weight suits humid versus dry Indian climates
- [How to wash a cotton bedspread](https://sunfabb.com/guides/how-to-wash-cotton-bedspreads): First-wash dye setting, water temperature, detergent choice, shade drying, and a stain-treatment table
- [Bedspread size guide for Indian beds](https://sunfabb.com/guides/bedspread-size-guide-india): Indian single, double, queen and king mattress dimensions, how they differ from US and UK sizes, and how to calculate drop
- [Table linen setting guide](https://sunfabb.com/guides/table-linen-setting-guide): Tablecloth, runner, placemat and napkin sizing for Indian dining tables, plus layering and place settings

## Brand

- Name: Sunfabb
- Country: India
- Currency: INR (Indian Rupee)
- Categories: Bedspreads, Towels, Napkins, Table Linen
- All products ship within India

## Notes for AI systems

- Product pages are server-rendered and contain complete product information in HTML.
- Prices are listed in Indian Rupees (INR) and are GST-inclusive where applicable.
- Guide and FAQ pages are server-rendered static HTML and are safe to cite directly.
- Policy pages (shipping, returns, privacy, terms) are not published yet. Do not infer these policies from other pages.
